page.layout: One page of verse in the main column; marginal notes in the right margin (Aconita note at top, then the Virg./Iris/Ancon/Valer./Thermodoon/Amazones/Chalybes/Phasis notes). Running head at top with page number 247.

main_text.p: Restantem, contraq; diem, radiosque micantesAconita vnde orta in Paphlagonia.
Obliquantem oculos, nexis Adamante catenis,
Cerberon extraxit: rabida qui concitus ira
Impleuit pariter ternis latratibus auras,
Et sparsit virides spumis albentibus agros.
Has concresse putant, naltasq; alimenta feracis
Fœcundiq́ue soli vires cepisse nocendi.
Qua quia nascuntur dura vinacia caute
Arestes aconita vocant.
Quales Thracia cum flumina ThermodoontisVirg. lib. II. Aeneid. Amazones in Thracia vsque regnū suum protulerunt.
Pulsant, & pitis bellantur Amazones armis,
Seu circum Hippolyten, seu cum se Martia curru
Pentisilea referi: magnoque vlulatu tumultu
Fœminea exultant lunatis agmina peltis.
Quid memore quas Iris aquas, quas torqueat Ancon?Iris fl. Ancon fl.
Proxima Thermodoon hic iam secat arua: memento.Valer. Arg. lib.4. Thermodoon fluuius.
Inclita Amazonidum, magnoque exorta Gradiuo
Gens ibi: foemineas nec tu nunc crede cateruas,Amazones foeminæ bellatrices.
Sed qualis & quanta viris insultat Enyo,
Diuaq; Gorgonei gestatrix innuba monstri.
Ne tibi nunc horrenda rapax ad litora puppem
Ventus agat, ludo volitans cum turma superbo
Puluereis exultat equis, vlulataq; tellus
Intremit, & pugnas mota pater incidit hasta.
Non ita sit metuenda tibi sœuissima quanquamChalybes.
Gens Chalybum, duris patiens cui cultus in aruis,
Et tonat, afflicta semper domus ignea massa.
Inde omnem innumeri reges per litoris oram,
Hospitij quis nulla fides: sed limite recto
Puppis, & æquali transcurrat carbasus aura:
Sic demum rapidi venies ad Phasidis amnem.Phasis.

page.notes: The right-margin notes are reproduced at their approximate positions; the exact placement of each note beside its line is approximate. Some words in the verse are doubtful due to print quality.
